errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only approved educators can do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This entry no longer exists. Refresh the page.

page.title: Invite parents
page.subtitle: Parents own their child’s profile. You send an invitation, and they decide what to share with you.

bulk.title: Invite by phone number
bulk.sub: For children who aren’t registered yet. Paste your whole group at once.
bulk.label: Parents’ phone numbers

why.short: This number is incomplete: 9 digits should follow +998, and there are only {d}.
why.long: This number is too long: 9 digits should follow +998, and there are {d}.
why.country: This isn’t an Uzbek number. Invitations go to +998 numbers only.
why.chars: The line has characters other than digits.

bulk.badTail: Fix or remove it — the others will be sent either way.
bulk.tooMany: Up to {max} numbers at a time. Split the list in two.
bulk.fromMatch: Add the parent’s number at the end of the list — the invitation goes out with the rest.
bulk.smsText: {name} has invited you to Zinapo. Add your child and choose what to share with your child’s educator. It takes about a minute: {link}. The link works for {days} days.
bulk.smsMeta: Your code {code} is recorded when a parent opens the link.
bulk.sentD: Parents have {days} days to respond — until {date}. You’ll see who joined below.

errors.TOO_MANY_PHONES: You can send up to 200 numbers at a time.

match.title: Child already registered?
match.sub: Enter both the PINFL and the family name. There’s no search by PINFL alone.
match.matchD: This is only to confirm you typed it correctly. The request goes to the parent who owns the profile and expires after 14 days.
match.requestedNote: Until the parent responds, you can’t send another request for this child.
match.linkActive: You already have access to this child. They appear in your groups.
match.linkRequested: Your request for this child is already waiting for the parent. You can’t send another until they respond.
match.linkSuspended: Your access to this child is suspended for now. You can’t send a new request.
match.noMatchD: There’s no profile with this PINFL and family name. Check the digits and the spelling. If the child isn’t registered yet, invite the parent by phone.
match.pausedD: Three misses in a row. Try again after {time}. This limit protects children’s data from guessing.
match.limitD: You’ve used all {limit} checks for today. The limit resets tomorrow at 00:00. Phone invitations don’t count towards it.
match.checksNote: Three misses in a row pause checks for an hour. Every check is logged.

errors.PINFL_INVALID: A PINFL has 14 digits. Check them and enter it again.
errors.FAMILY_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter the family name — there’s no check by PINFL alone.
errors.LINK_EXISTS: You already have a request or access for this child.
errors.DECLINED_THIS_SEASON: The parent declined your request this season. You can ask again next season.
errors.MATCH_TOKEN_INVALID: This check result has expired (15 minutes). Enter the details and check again.

status.title: Invitation status
status.sub: An invitation with no response expires after 14 days.
status.remindNote: Parents who haven’t opened the link yet: {n}. The reminder goes to their phones.
status.remindedNote: Reminder sent to parents: {n}. You can send the next one in {days} days.
status.remindNone: No one to remind yet. Recent invitations can be followed up in {days} days.
status.emptyD: Paste parents’ numbers into the field above and send. They’ll get a link by SMS, add their child and share access with you. You’ll see here who has joined.
status.errBody: Sent SMS and parents’ responses are safe. Check your connection and try again.
status.remindWait: You can send the next one from {date}.

landing.title: {name} invited you to Zinapo
landing.step1D: The profile is yours: you own it, not the educator.
landing.step2D: The educator sees only what you allow. You decide.
landing.step3D: Switch access off in one tap; when it runs out, it closes by itself.
landing.privacy: The educator never sees your phone number or your other children.
landing.ctaSignIn: Sign in and add your child
landing.deadTitle: This invitation has expired or was already used
landing.deadBody: The link no longer works. Ask the educator for a new invitation, or sign in and add your child yourself.
landing.errBody: Check your connection and try again.

apply.title: Apply as an educator
apply.subtitle: The trust & safety team reviews every application. Once approved, you invite parents and see the results of the children they share with you.

kindHint.tutor: I teach privately — at home or online
kindHint.school_teacher: I teach a class or a subject at a school
kindHint.learning_centre: I work at a learning centre

apply.schoolErr: We couldn’t load the schools — you can continue without one.
apply.subjects: Which areas do you work on?
apply.rejectedD: You can update your details and apply again.

errors.SCHOOL_NOT_IN_REGION: That school isn’t in this region. Choose the school again.

apply.regionsErrBody: The application needs a region. Check your connection and try again.

pending.title: Application under review
pending.subtitle: The trust & safety team is reviewing your application. It usually takes one or two working days.
pending.next1: The trust & safety team checks your details.
pending.next2: You’ll get a Telegram message when there’s a decision.
pending.next3: Once approved, you invite parents and build groups.
pending.nowD: Nothing involving children opens before approval — no invitations, no results. This protects parents and children.
pending.rejectedBody: The trust & safety team didn’t approve the application. You can update your details and apply again.
pending.errBody: Check your connection and try again.
